Librogame.title: 40 Seconds Left
Librogame.author: Andrea Carbone

Changes.Change: Adapted for this app: the structure, the rules and parts of the text were changed or removed to work with its engine
Translated into English from the original Italian

Librogame.ContentWarnings: A suicide asked of another person, schizophrenia and hallucinations, stabbings, the death of the protagonist and of his partner, coarse language. The story is fragmented and disturbing by design.
Librogame.Blurb:
You have forty seconds left to live, and you don't know why. In the bathroom mirror of a motel you see only a black halo; next door, in the bedroom, is Lisa, your girlfriend, with a knife in her hand.
You must find out why, and how to survive. Twenty-one short, broken paragraphs, like the mind of the man living them.

Page.Text:
You have 40 seconds left to live. You must find out why, and how to survive.
You look in the bathroom mirror, but all you see is a black halo.

Choice.text: You wipe the mirror
You go into the bedroom

Page.Text: You have 10 seconds left to live. On the other side you glimpse the motel room you came from. You see your own body, and Lisa's. Your girlfriend is about to strike you with a knife.

Choice.text: You scream at both of them, begging them to stop
You enjoy the scene

Page.Text:
You have 20 seconds left to live. You look out of the window: you are in a motel, on the second floor. It is fucking freezing, you are bare-chested and you feel it in every hair on your body.
Lisa comes towards you with the knife.

Choice.text: You throw yourself down and aim for the dumpsters, hoping they will break your fall
You let her come closer

Page.Text:
You land on the dumpsters on one shoulder. You dislocate it, but you are alive. Like a frightened dog, you run away from that place.
You are alone. You are alive.

Lisa drives the knife in at the height of your heart, just as you asked her to an hour ago. You had to convince her with everything you had. Now you have what you wanted. You will spend the seconds you have left looking into her eyes, blue as the sea.
Then everything will go black.

You have put the shards back together. Well done. Now you understand where the problem with your mind lies: broken. In pieces.
You are ready to put it back together.

Peace at last. You close your eyes and everything goes BLACK.
Your 40 seconds are up. Somewhere, in another universe, a knife has gone into a body.

You have 30 Seconds left to live. The chair hits Lisa full on and she collapses to the floor, but the knife stays in her hands. The exit door is behind her, but you also notice the window, two steps away from you.

Choice.text: You head for the exit door, walking right past her, since she is stunned
You head for the window

Page.Text: You have 38 seconds left to live. It wasn't a halo, but a vision of shadows, the same ones that haunt you. Oh right, you're schizophrenic. The shadows wrap themselves around you.

Choice.text: You scream to make them go away
You rip the mirror off the wall and throw it on the floor

Page.Text: You fall onto the concrete pavement and hit your head on it. You will spend your last 10 seconds watching the motel's neon lights flicker, before everything goes dark.
Lisa and your own self stop. They stare at you, astonished. At the very moment your eyes meet, you collapse into a black spiral you will never get out of. O b l i v i o n.

You have 33 seconds left to live. The mirror shatters. In each of the pieces you glimpse a part of your body. You don't recognise yourself. The doctor's words echo in your head: "Your mind is divided into watertight compartments that do not communicate with one another."
Lisa has come up behind you: your girlfriend is holding a knife and is ready to run you through.

Choice.text: You grab one of the shards of the mirror and defend yourself with it, aiming at her belly
You know she won't do it: you go back to the shards and try to fit them together into a whole picture of your mind

Page.Text: You have 35 seconds left to live. Lisa is in the bedroom with the knife in her hand, coming towards you, trembling but determined.

Choice.text: You ask her to explain
You throw a chair at her

Page.Text:
You have 10 seconds left to live. Lisa crashes to the ground. Your femoral artery has been cleanly severed. You studied enough medicine to know you had better spend the next 10 seconds holding her rather than trying uselessly to stop the bleeding.
You fall asleep together.

You have 30 seconds left to live.
You scream, and the mantle of black dissolves. You are in a white, empty space. It feels like a ball of cotton wool. At last you feel you can rest.

Choice.text: You lie down and enjoy the peace of the silence
You notice a black dot, an eyelet fixed in the void. You go closer to look inside

Page.Text:
You have 20 seconds left to live.
She tells you, furious, that you were the one who convinced her to do it in the first place. You can't change your mind now, just like that, out of nowhere. She comes towards you, ready to strike.

Choice.text: You let her strike, since it can't be real. It's all a fantasy of your sick mind
You try to escape towards the window
You throw a chair at her

Page.Text:
You have 10 seconds left to live.
You are too agitated to take aim. Lisa dodges the chair and comes towards you.

Choice.text: You let her do it
You throw yourself out of the window without looking at what is below

Page.Text: You strike Lisa before she can do it to you. Simple and painless. She slumps down beside you. She falls asleep. You are alive. But you have lost the last shred of humanity you had left.

You watch the scene blissfully: Lisa stabs you in the chest and your body crashes to the ground. But you are fine, in your cotton-wool world where nothing and no one will ever disturb you again. You fall asleep like a baby.

You have 20 seconds left to live.
Lisa grabs you by the ankle just as you walk past her and drives the knife into your calf. You scream.

Choice.text: You kick her with all your strength with your other leg
You try to reach the door anyway

Page.Text: Lisa won't let go of you. In fact, she pulls out the knife, gets up and calls to you. You turn round.
